composition_subtypes.role: maintains window of k+1 consecutive free rooms
adjusts median pointer m within window to minimize max distance

payload.core_composition_summary: Sliding window of size k+1 over sorted free rooms with two-pointer to find optimal median for min-max distance.
payload.rationale: Outer loop slides l and r over free indices; inner while moves m to minimize max(m-l, r-m) amortized O(n). Both pointers monotonic.
